mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every nonconstant torus character of the raw Laurent-unit vector detects a change in an actual positive mask or target-distance collision profile.
would_close: unit Fourier rigidity with distance meaning
mechanisms.kill_test: Use the exact fixed-X gauge line; a nonconstant raw character with all observable products and labels constant kills the claim.
mechanisms.status_evidence: A nonconstant raw character detects the fixed-X gauge generator while all source/complement products and labels are constant. Evidence: evidence/FIXED_X_UNIT_RANK_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: After fixing common X and normalized quotient vectors, the raw legal Laurent-unit fibre has t^o(1) elements.
mechanisms.kill_test: Exhibit arbitrarily many rational or bounded-denominator gauge representatives at the same fixed X and normalized data.
mechanisms.status_evidence: The exact fixed-X system admits infinitely many rational and integer representatives along its primitive gauge line. Evidence: evidence/FIXED_X_UNIT_RANK_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Fixed source and complement Newton widths bound every individual factor unit to an interval of t^o(1) integer length.
mechanisms.kill_test: Move along the exact gauge line while every source/complement width and absolute product support remains fixed.
mechanisms.status_evidence: Individual factor valuations are unbounded along gauge although every observable product support is fixed. Evidence: evidence/FIXED_X_UNIT_RANK_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every nonzero legal factor-unit displacement crosses a Newton-face or tangent-order wall and therefore changes an actual distance label.
mechanisms.kill_test: The exact gauge displacement is nonzero for arbitrary delta but preserves every normalized face, tangent square and distance label.
mechanisms.status_evidence: Arbitrary nonzero gauge displacement changes no Newton face, tangent ordering or target label. Evidence: evidence/FIXED_X_UNIT_RANK_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Distinct fixed-X Laurent-unit vectors with the same normalized quotient data induce distinct target-target collision multiplicity profiles up to universally bounded ambiguity.
mechanisms.kill_test: Enumerate many exact gauge representatives; unboundedly many vectors with one identical collision profile kill bounded ambiguity.
mechanisms.status_evidence: Unboundedly many fixed-X raw vectors induce one exact target collision profile. Evidence: evidence/FIXED_X_UNIT_RANK_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Large additive energy of a fixed-X raw unit fibre forces a proportional increase in target-target collision energy.
mechanisms.kill_test: A long arithmetic progression in the gauge parameter has maximal additive structure while the target configuration and collision energy remain unchanged.
mechanisms.status_evidence: Long arithmetic progressions in gauge have high additive energy and constant collision geometry. Evidence: evidence/FIXED_X_UNIT_RANK_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For the exact three-row paired-positive block, fixing common X and the six source/complement product units leaves exactly one gauge direction; imposing u(G)=a selects a unique representative and preserves every geometric label.
mechanisms.kill_test: Independently row-reduce the seven unit variables and verify uniqueness, gauge invariance and absence of torsion.
mechanisms.status_evidence: The exact unit matrix has rank six, primitive kernel rank one, and u(G)=a gives a unique lossless gauge slice. Evidence: evidence/FIXED_X_UNIT_RANK_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: In every actual power-large paired-positive common-X block, the integer unit constraint quotient has rank zero and t^o(1) torsion after projective gauge fixing.
mechanisms.kill_test: Search small factor-incidence matrices for positive observable quotient rank or growing torsion; the exact three-row block is only the first test.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every bit of conditional entropy in the raw unit vector after fixing X and normalized data consumes a distinct paired-positive carrier or a distance label.
mechanisms.kill_test: Bounded gauge samples have arbitrarily growing raw entropy but exactly zero observable entropy and no new carrier or label.
mechanisms.status_evidence: Raw conditional entropy grows with the bounded gauge sample while observable entropy, carriers and labels remain constant. Evidence: evidence/FIXED_X_UNIT_RANK_FALSIFICATION.md.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The number of legal raw unit representatives is within a universal constant factor of the number of target-order or collision chambers they realize.
mechanisms.kill_test: Arbitrarily many exact gauge representatives lie in one target and collision chamber, killing constant-factor comparison.
mechanisms.status_evidence: Arbitrarily many exact gauge representatives occupy one target-order and collision chamber. Evidence: evidence/FIXED_X_UNIT_RANK_FALSIFICATION.md.
